title: The Honest Farmer
request: use my script about the honest farmer as it is

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hello everyone, today I am going to tell you a very old story about a farmer and a bag of gold.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Once upon a time, in a small village near a big castle, there lived a poor farmer named Tomas who worked in his field every single day from morning until night but he never had enough money to buy good food for his family.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One morning, when he was walking to the market, he saw something lying on the road, and when he went closer he saw that it was a heavy bag, and inside the bag there were 100 gold coins.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tomas had never seen so much money in his whole life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He thought about his hungry children.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He thought about his broken roof.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody was on the road and nobody had seen him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But then he saw that the bag had the mark of the queen on it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For 3 days Tomas could not sleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: His wife told him to keep the gold because the queen was rich and would never miss it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the third night he made his decision.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He walked all the way to the castle and the soldiers at the gate laughed at him because of his old clothes, but he told them that he had something that belonged to the queen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The queen was very surprised when she saw the bag.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She counted the coins and all 100 were there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She asked him why he did not keep it, since nobody would have known.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tomas said that he would have known.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The queen was quiet for a long time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then she said that she had lost that bag on purpose, because she wanted to find one honest person in her kingdom to look after the royal treasure.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She gave Tomas 10 gold coins every month for the rest of his life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And from that day the people of the village said that an honest man sleeps well even on a hard bed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thank you for watching.
